# A temporary LIKE, COPY or CLONE of a temporary table, as BigQuery answers.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language.md

CREATE TEMP TABLE s (id INT64);
INSERT s (id) VALUES (1);
CREATE TEMP TABLE n LIKE s;
INSERT n (id) VALUES (2);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT id FROM n))
=> "[2]"

CREATE TEMP TABLE s (id INT64);
CREATE TEMP TABLE n LIKE s AS SELECT 2 AS id;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT id FROM n))
=> "[2]"

CREATE TEMP TABLE s (id INT64);
INSERT s (id) VALUES (1);
CREATE TEMP TABLE n COPY s;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT id FROM n))
=> "[1]"

CREATE TEMP TABLE s (id INT64);
INSERT s (id) VALUES (1);
CREATE TEMP TABLE n CLONE s;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT id FROM n))
=> "[1]"
